notes.title: Beware The Ghost is Out Now!
notes.content:
Enjoy some spooky local multiplayer mayhem!
Terrorize your friends in 7 haunted locations. Play as a furniture-possessing ghost on one screen while your friends explore a haunted house on another. Or play co-operatively against waves of pumpkins.

notes.title: Releasing October 1st
notes.content:
Beware The Ghost will be released on October 1st by the stroke of midnight! Grab your friends and enjoy some spooky local multiplayer shenanigans.
